analysis.summary: Dextr is the smallest publisher here: 41 pages, no new ones in 30 days. Rivals run far larger libraries and mix product pages with guides, research and case studies.

points.text: Akia leans hardest on teaching content, with 24 how-to pages and 22 learning-stage pages, while Dextr has almost none.
Actabl and Operto publish labor and staffing content, the area closest to Dextr's back-office pitch, and Actabl backs it with research and case studies.
Canary and Duve mostly refresh product and customer-proof pages, while Dextr has only 4 updates and 0 new pages.

Dextr.play: Small set of landing pages for hotel back office and rentals, plus a partnership and a security page.

Canary Technologies.play: Wide product catalog of guest-tech pages, with AI voice, chat and sales agents pushed in updates.

ALICE (Actabl).play: Labor cost research, profitability reports and case studies that lead into AI labor and finance tools.

Akia.play: Large library of guides on AI agents, front desk and reviews, feeding AI receptionist and messaging products.
Akia.aimed: Hotels and rental managers researching AI

Duve.play: Refreshes customer ROI case studies and guest app, upsell and AI communication product pages.

Operto.play: Case studies plus AI agent guides and an anti-OTA (online booking sites) direct-booking campaign.
Operto.aimed: Hotels and rental managers, direct-booking focus

shared.title: Customer proof
shared.text: Duve (8 case studies), Operto (13) and Canary (6) publish customer stories, many refreshed this month. Dextr has none listed, so buyers see less proof.

shared.title: AI agent education
shared.text: Akia and Operto publish guides on what AI agents are and what to automate first. They shape early buyer thinking, a stage where Dextr is quiet.

shared.title: Product page refresh
shared.text: Canary (42 landing pages), Duve (8) and Akia (16) updated many product pages. It looks like a push to keep AI messaging current.

gaps.title: Staffing and housekeeping guides
gaps.text: Actabl owns labor-cost data, but nobody publishes practical AI guides on hotel staffing, scheduling or housekeeping. Dextr already sells this and could teach it.

gaps.title: Hotel AI security guides
gaps.text: Only Dextr has a data-protection page. Operators worry about guest data, so a buyer's checklist or guide could stand out.

gaps.title: Short-term rental AI workforce content
gaps.text: Akia and Operto cover rentals mostly through guest messaging and KPIs. Few pieces cover AI for rental operations like cleaning and maintenance, which Dextr's page targets.
